mapper.sql: select n.notice_id, n.community_id, n.notice_title, n.notice_type, n.notice_content, n.status, n.publish_time, n.del_flag, n.create_by, n.create_time, n.update_by, n.update_time, n.remark, c.community_name from pms_notice n left join pms_community c on n.community_id = c.community_id
mapper.insert: insert into pms_notice (community_id, notice_title, notice_type, notice_content, status, publish_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{communityId}, #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeType}, #{noticeContent}, #{status}, #{publishTime}, '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.delete: update pms_notice set del_flag = '2' where notice_id = #{noticeId}
update pms_notice set del_flag = '2' where notice_id in #{noticeId}
